shellCommands.command: (npx next start -p 3111 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 6 && echo "=== TIME TO FIRST BYTE / FULL ===" && curl -s -o /tmp/product.html -w "ttfb=%{time_starttransfer}s total=%{time_total}s\n" http://localhost:3111/product

cd /tmp && echo "=== ORDER OF APPEARANCE IN HTML ===" && grep -o -n -E 'Premium Widget|Checking stock|in stock|Price: \$' product.html | head && echo && echo "=== does the FIRST flush carry the title? ===" && curl -s --limit-rate 200000 -N http://localhost:3111/product | head -c 900 | grep -o -E 'Premium Widget|Checking stock|in stock'

echo "=== prerendered shell on disk ===" && ls .next/server/app/product* 2>/dev/null && grep -c 'Premium Widget' .next/server/app/product.html 2>/dev/null && echo "(title present in static shell)" && echo && echo "=== git status ===" && git status --short && echo && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
cat .gitignore && echo "=== rebuild (confirm tsconfig stays put + still PPR) ===" && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -14 && echo "=== tsconfig re-touched by build? ===" && git diff --stat tsconfig.json

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "servers stopped"; echo "=== final diff ==="; git --no-pager diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json; echo "=== status ==="; git status --short
git --no-pager diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json; echo "=== status ==="; git status --short; echo "=== leftover servers ==="; pgrep -af "next-server|next start" || echo none
pgrep -af "next" | grep -v pgrep | grep -v "bin/bash" || echo "no next processes running"
